profile.headline: Embedded Software Engineer @ Hach
profile.summary: Full‑stack engineer with a focus on building intuitive, high‑performance user interfaces. I blend embedded systems experience with modern frontend development, creating seamless interactions between hardware and software.

positions.title: Embedded Software Engineer (UI)
positions.description: Combining embedded systems development with front-end architecture for device management and firmware workflows.
positions.insights: Embedded Software Programming, TypeScript and +6 skills

positions.title: Contract Firmware Engineer
positions.description: Developing responsive web applications utilizing MVC architecture and Atomic UI design, ensuring seamless cross-device compatibility.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed, developed, and tested software components for Battery Manager systems. 

Designed and developed web-based applications and GUI frontends, with API and SQL development on the backend.

Day to day support activities, including resolving system bugs and assisting with customer/site support.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.locationName: Atlantic City, New Jersey, United States
positions.description:
Partnered with the FAA to upgrade hardware and software capabilities to meet the increased amount of data the Surveillance Branch must process and record.

Updated user interface for both inputing data requests and outputting analytical results and dashboard-type web pages showing overall real-time and historical system performance.

projects.title: PassportIQ
projects.description: PassportIQ is a SaaS platform designed to help companies generate, manage, and maintain Digital Product Passports (DPPs) for compliance with upcoming EU regulations. It enables structured lifecycle data tracking for industrial products, with a focus on batteries and regulated manufacturing supply chains. Built to simplify compliance, improve traceability, and support scalable reporting requirements for evolving sustainability standards.
